requirement: App Statistic reads JoomlArt as the account source of a first sign-in through JoomlArt, and Tracy answers /favicon.ico with its own icon instead of treating it as a site address

oracle.invariant: The JoomlArt account with no utm reads source {source: joomlart} in users, quickstarts and detail; the source filter joomlart lists it and the source options include joomlart. A JoomlArt account whose link carried utm medium/campaign keeps them and gains source joomlart; one whose link named utm_source newsletter keeps newsletter. A Google first sign-in with no utm stays unknown (source null): a way to sign in is not an acquisition source. GET /favicon.ico on Tracy's hostname answers 200 image/svg+xml with exactly the icon page-shell pages declare, signed out and signed in (before: 302 to /login or to /favicon-ico-…/join). GET /favicon.ico on a site hostname is not answered with Tracy's icon. The /ops bundle's index.html declares <link rel=icon type=image/svg+xml href=/favicon.svg> and its public/favicon.svg equals that icon byte for byte.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
